bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed after search; nonclear bags receive extra inspection. Backpacks, Camelbaks and bota bags are not allowed.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Self-parking is complimentary in Disney Springs’ Watermelon surface lot and Lime and Orange garages. Arrive at least 60 minutes before the scheduled show because capacity and entry can be restricted.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ gives its Disney Springs location but does not designate a House of Blues-specific rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The restaurant, bar, Smokehouse and Music Hall offer food and drinks and accept cards or mobile pay; free cash-to-card conversion is available. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Contact the box office to request an ADA accommodation; the venue publishes an additional accessibility guide.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests cannot re-enter a concert after leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens at 2 p.m. on concert nights and noon–7 p.m. on Wednesdays. Check the purchase confirmation for any show-specific will-call arrangement.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Security searches bags before entry. The box office opens at 2 p.m. on concert nights, and event listings give the door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
